Today's Tech News Digest — AI Agents

The AI agent landscape is shifting rapidly from experimentation to production. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a production milestone, with adoption tripling as enterprises embrace decentralized AI workflows. Model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration in startups, prioritizing flexibility over rigid pipelines.

Reliability is the new frontier: tool-calling accuracy has become the key benchmark for frontier models, while multi-agent swarms are graduating from demos to regulated enterprise environments. Meanwhile, the industry is converging on observability standards to trace agent decisions end to end — a crucial step toward accountability at scale.

The message is clear: agents are moving from labs to live systems, and the focus has shifted from capability to dependability.
